copyFailuresDuringCapture.scope: Cumulative PlayerBridge copy-failure counter delta observed during the window; not attributable to individual motion-feed acquisitions.

admission.firstAttempt: rejected-before-feed-start: confirmed layout did not match the latest clear detector sample
admission.successfulAttempt: after user reconfirmation, seeded from a fresh detector sample matching the confirmed layout

interpretation: No exact-frame/source-clock candidate unavailability or duplicate receipts occurred during this run. The five source-time gaps were all about 133-136 ms with four decoded frame IDs between motion samples. Four gap-associated acquisitions used two attempts and took about 41-76 ms; their associated worker times were about 13-23 ms. The one-second acquisition and worker P95 values include all sampled intervals and do not identify the cause of every gap. The PlayerBridge changed-during-copy counter rose by 19 during the window, matching the feed retry count numerically, but it is app-wide cumulative telemetry and cannot be assigned to specific feed attempts. This supports testing a smaller readback for the ROI-only motion diagnostic; it does not establish that readback size is the sole cause, or prove moving-ball accuracy. The 125 ms reset threshold is unchanged.
